scope: Independent source review of staged Rust PS GPIO core and ABI, plus QEMU C binding and board/clock/reset patch. Not an execution result.
checks: Four banks have widths32/22/32/32 and exact register decoding; invalid accesses precede mutation.
Masked writes match literal UG585 example0xbdef4210; DATA latches and external input samples remain separate.
MIO7/8 DATA_RO read known0; caller cannot supply them as general inputs. No interrupt pad value is fabricated.
IRQ52 is the OR of all enabled sources. Table14-1 trigger modes, edge latch W1C, live level status and unknown propagation follow chapter14.2.4.
INT_MASK reset0 and INT_TYPE resetones match AppendixB; unknown MIO latches/external samples remain explicit.
GPIO_CPU1X_RST resets only the bus interface per14.4.2; warm reset preserves controller state. Cold reset is a distinct Rust operation.
ABI pointers have documented ownership; invalid output calls retain destination, u32 bank cannot truncate to valid u8, null IRQ is unknown.
C rejects non-word, misaligned, unknown and gated/reset accesses. IRQ consumers receive errors rather than fabricated unknown success.
CPU_1x/APer22 and GPIO_RST_CTRL bit0 are used; no MIO mux, synchronizer latency or physical pad timing is claimed.
disposition: Source review permits integration and focused checks. Actual Rust and QEMU tests remain required.
